description: This file defines the `TextWatcherWrapper` class which implements the `TextWatcher` interface from Android. It delegates only the `afterTextChanged` event to a specified listener, effectively wrapping and filtering text change events for use within an Android application. The class also contains an internal interface `OnTextChangedListener` for callbacks. It is part of an NFC provisioning sample app.

classes.name: TextWatcherWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class implementing `TextWatcher` that delegates `afterTextChanged` events to a listener, ignoring other events.

classes.name: OnTextChangedListener
classes.description: An internal interface defining a callback method `onTextChanged` with an ID and string parameter.

methods.name: TextWatcherWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ID and listener for event delegation.

methods.name: beforeTextChanged
methods.description: Overrides the `TextWatcher` method to ignore the `beforeTextChanged` event.

methods.name: onTextChanged
methods.description: Overrides the `TextWatcher` method to ignore the `onTextChanged` event.

methods.name: afterTextChanged
methods.description: Overrides the `TextWatcher` method to pass the changed text to the listener via `onTextChanged` callback.
